facts.fact: The Star reports the Commission on Revenue Allocation told the Senate ICT committee that more than 33 counties contracted fintechs to set up systems and collect revenue, automating only a small share of revenue streams, with Nairobi's e-JijiPay running parking, market fees and permits.
facts.system: e-JijiPay and other county revenue systems

facts.fact: The Commission on Revenue Allocation said more than 33 counties had contracted fintechs to set up systems and collect revenue, a floor with no stated number live.
Fintechs such as JamboPay, River Bank and Sense Networks set up and run the county revenue systems for one-off fees and commissions of about 4 to 15 per cent of collections.

KEN.note: Nothing about mobile money or retail payment services.

facts.fact: The Star reports Nairobi County's e-JijiPay, run by JamboPay, collects single business permits, market fees, cess, slaughter and auction fees and parking through an electronic system, while most counties automated only a small share of revenue streams.

KEN.note: County revenue, not the national revenue authority.
